payload.rationale: Selected exactly two removals and four history interactions from the predeclared budget. Base expanding R1-D primary/H12 MAE 13.349836/15.577241. Removing codes gives primary 14.078598 but H12 15.053470: early H12 improves 17.795600 to16.132086 while late H12 worsens13.700392 to14.140896 and high-tail errors worsen. This is a substantive feature/history trade-off, not universal robustness. Removing cycle produces the largest primary removal cost (+0.864267) but nearly neutral pooled H12 (+0.004850), with early improvement and late loss, making it the second informative contrast. Full D recent8 primary13.217154 beats expanding13.349836 and matched8 samples13.501782/13.528531 at equal recent8 row count, but H12 worsens to15.794559; recent12 also fails to improve either H12. Interactions test whether category/cycle removal changes that recency-versus-count contrast. No scope/spread, telemetry or text-load addbacks: their primary removal costs are small positive and lack a stronger horizon contrast. All four recipes retain fixed HGB settings, selected-feature parsers and same outer windows. This is adaptive development evidence selected from reused validation outcomes. No official Test feature diagnostics or Kaggle scores were consulted for this selection; no further recipe selection follows these interactions.
payload.interpretation: Adaptive development interaction; not independent confirmation.
